contentBlocks.title: SASSA Required Documents Checklist
contentBlocks.description: Having the right documents ready speeds up your SASSA grant application. Use our complete checklist to make sure you have everything you need — from your ID to bank statements and medical reports.

contentBlocks.text: Having the correct documents ready before you apply for a SASSA grant will save you time and prevent delays. Below is the complete checklist of documents you may need.
Certified copies — the one thing people forget

Most people arrive with the right documents but uncertified copies. A 'certified copy' is one stamped by a police officer at any SAPS station or by a commissioner of oaths, signed within the last few months. You do not need new certification for every single document — just for the important ones like your ID and any legal documents. If you are not sure whether a copy is acceptable, get it certified anyway. It costs nothing at a police station and it is the single most common reason applications get sent back.

items: Bring originals too — SASSA staff may want to see the originals alongside your certified copies
Copy both sides of your ID if there is anything printed on the back
Make two copies of everything — one goes in, one stays home with you
Bank statements must show your full name and the last 3 months of activity
If you do not have a bill in your name, ask your traditional leader or ward councillor for a letter confirming where you live

contentBlocks.title: Running low on money for copies?
contentBlocks.text: Copies are usually free or very cheap at SASSA offices. Ask before you pay anywhere else — and remember no SASSA official ever charges you for a grant application.

documents.label: Original 13-digit barcoded Smart Card ID or green ID book
Proof of Residence — utility bill in your name (last 3 months)
documents.notes: Or letter from traditional leader or ward councillor

documents.label: Last 3 months bank statements showing all deposits
Sworn affidavit confirming unemployment (stamped at SAPS)
Marriage certificate, divorce order, or death certificate of spouse
SASSA medical assessment report
documents.notes: For Disability Grant and Care Dependency Grant
